title: Green Tulip
body:
"Green tulips are unique flowers with green petals, symbolizing fertility and renewal."

Description


The Green Tulip are sellable common flowers, that can be found around in the Finlay and Flowering Meadows regions. It can be sold to Jer Junkman for 25$ per tulip. It can be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~1.92% per flower.
